title: Prince Shotoku (Shotoku Taishi)
biography: Semi-legendary regent who authored Japan's Seventeen-Article Constitution, established the Twelve Level Cap and Rank System, and built Horyu-ji, the world's oldest surviving wooden building.
internationalConnections: Sent formal diplomatic missions to Sui Dynasty China with the famous letter: 'From the Son of Heaven in the land where the sun rises to the Son of Heaven in the land where the sun sets.'
